name: PPTX Motion Lab design system
about: One source of truth for what looks good and how it is built. Generators (motion_engine, motion_director, motion_components, morph_studio, slide_forge) read these values; validators and scripts/design_critic.py check decks against the same values. A band is [good_min, good_max]; a limit is [hard_min, hard_max]: outside the band is a note, outside the limit is a warning. Easing curves live in scripts/motion_tokens.py (fitted from Carbon/Material); this file names the roles. Sources are listed at the end and in docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md.

rules.statement: Every effect lasts what its role allows: entrances 250-700 ms, exits 200-500, emphasis 250-600, moves 400-1200 scaled with distance, Morph 1.0-1.6 s.
Moves slow in and slow out (role easing); nothing important moves at constant speed.
Stagger only to show order, 60-150 ms between items; common fate (moving together) beats a long cascade for tracking.
At most about four independent things move at once in a click; objects moving together count as one.
One idea per click, at most six clicks per slide.
One motion language per deck: 3-10 effect kinds, lifecycles over exotic presets.
Structure (process, data, pictures) moves; at most 30% of content slides stay still.
Ambient loops are slow (cycle >= 6 s) and never on the object being discussed.
Titles stay still inside a slide; they move only by Morph.
A slide that leaves by Morph ends on its authored layout, or objects snap back when the transition starts.
Text contrast >= 4.5:1, large text (>= 18 pt, or 14 pt bold) >= 3:1.
Generated motion helpers (halo, ring, rail, token, marker, underline) reach >= 3:1 against what is behind them (marker: a tint behind text, exempt).
A deck uses 3-6 text sizes, title about 1.5-2.6x body, body >= 18 pt (never below 12).
One or two type families per deck.
A slide carries a claim and its evidence: <= 45 words is good, > 80 is a wall of text.
The settled frame keeps 60-95% background and its visual weight near the centre.
Content sits inside the slide with a 3% safe margin; off-slide objects only as Morph staging.
